## Behavior

Describe the concrete problem and the resulting behavior. Include a sanitized trigger or event sequence where useful.

## Validation

- [ ] Relevant tests and build/test/lint results included
- [ ] Eval changes explained, including any misses or benign asks
- [ ] Docs and verified/unverified assumptions updated where contracts change
- [ ] Fixtures and logs contain no real credentials or private content

Commands run, results, and remaining limitations:

## Security implications

Describe any changed trust boundaries, defaults, fail modes or false positives. For an undisclosed vulnerability, use SECURITY.md instead of a public PR.
